SourceProxy.name: SHYXSurfaceThickness
SourceProxy.label: SHYX Surface Thickness

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Surface Thickness: Per-vertex wall thickness (self-proximity default, or inward ray / shape diameter).

SourceProxy.Documentation:
Copies the input surface and writes point arrays Thickness, ThicknessOverEdgeLength, ThicknessValid, and LocalEdgeLength. Color by Thickness (or ThicknessOverEdgeLength for collapse relative to the mesh size). Thickness = 0 with ThicknessValid = 1 is coincident kissing / crossing; Thickness = -1 with ThicknessValid = 0 means no opposite was found inside Max Distance.
Self-proximity (default) does not ray-cast, so crossing faces still give a usable value (nearest Euclidean neighbor outside a small geodesic ring, optionally in the inward half-space). Ray along normal and Shape diameter shoot inward and are unreliable on self-intersections.
Max Distance 0 uses 5% of the longest AABB side (BoundsDomain scaled_extent 0.05); use Scale/Reset next to the property.

IntVectorProperty.name: Method
IntVectorProperty.label: Method
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Self-proximity: nearest Euclidean neighbor that is outside Geodesic Rings hops (works with crossing faces). Ray along normal: first inward hit. Shape diameter: median of cone rays around the inward axis.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MaxDistance
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Max Distance
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Search / ray length. 0 (default) uses 0.05 times the longest side of the input axis-aligned bounding box (BoundsDomain scaled_extent). The panel Scale/Reset controls fill that suggestion.

IntVectorProperty.name: FlipNormals
IntVectorProperty.label: Flip Normals
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Treat the mesh winding as inward-pointing (inward = +n instead of -n). Use when Thickness looks like it was measured outward into empty space.

IntVectorProperty.name: GeodesicRings
IntVectorProperty.label: Geodesic Rings
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Self-proximity: ignore vertices within this many edge hops so the same wall is not treated as the opposite wall. Keep small (2) so a coarse tube's opposite side is not excluded.

IntVectorProperty.name: InwardOnly
IntVectorProperty.label: Inward Only
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Self-proximity: only accept neighbors in the inward half-space (within 75 degrees of the inward axis). Turns off if normals are unusable; then coincident / kissing points still report Thickness 0.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: RayOffset
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Ray Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Inward start offset so the ray does not immediately hit the source face. 0 uses 0.25 times that vertex's mean incident edge length. If the wall is thinner than the offset, the ray can miss.

IntVectorProperty.name: RequireOppositeNormal
IntVectorProperty.label: Require Opposite Normal
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Ray methods: skip hits whose face normal points the same way as the query (grazing the same wall).

IntVectorProperty.name: NumberOfRays
IntVectorProperty.label: Number Of Rays
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Shape diameter: rays in the cone, including the inward axis. Thickness is the median of successful hits.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ConeAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Cone Angle (deg)
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Shape diameter cone half-angle in degrees around the inward axis. Ignored when Number Of Rays is 1.
